name: Uno Directory

sources.title: Submit Listing — redirects to sign-in (Google or email) before the form
Pricing — $10 one-time per listing; FAQ confirms free route via backlink verification
How to Submit — full requirements, free-vs-paid options, badge verification steps

conditions: Free listing requires placing an HTML verification badge on your site's homepage (Listed on uno directory) and passing their automated verify check
An account (email or Google sign-in) is required for either route
requirements: Account sign-in required before the submission form loads (/submit redirects to /api/auth/signin)
Tool must be functional and legitimate; no adult content, scams, IP violations, malware, or duplicate submissions
Accurate info and working URLs; descriptions should be original and non-spammy
Free route: badge must be visible on the homepage at verification time
preparation: Tagline plus a long description — 600-800 words recommended
Featured image, minimum 1200x630px recommended (OG image or screenshot)
For the free route: ability to edit the product homepage to add their badge HTML
workflow: Create an account or sign in at /auth/signup or /api/auth/signin (email or Google)
Open /submit and choose Free or Paid ($10 one-time) listing
Fill the form: name, URL, tagline, description, category/subcategory, tags, featured image
Free route: paste the badge code on the homepage, then click verify in the form
Submit — review is described as instant/automatic; paid listings activate after the $10 payment, free listings after backlink verification
watchFor: /submit shows only a sign-in wall until authenticated
Free listing is gated on a followed backlink badge — treat as conditional, not fully free
Site cross-promotes a Premium Launcher subscription covering partner platforms (Aura++, EarlyHunt, IndieHunt, MakerHunt, SideHunt) — ignore the upsell
Badge presumably must remain on the homepage; removing it may risk the listing
countsAsLive: The tool appears on a public listing page under uno.directory/listings/... and is reachable from its category listing
unknowns: Whether the 'instant' automated review ever rejects listings manually afterward
Whether the badge can be removed post-approval without delisting
Actual DR value of the listing link (dofollow vs tracked redirect)
